```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(treemap)

df_list <- readRDS("data/export.rds")

# Create plot theme
  my_plot_theme <- theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 20)),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.line  = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
```

## 📈 SERVICES by PLACE

📌 The figure below provides a comparative overview of the total number of healthcare services rendered **across all operational locations**[^1]

[^1]: CAM = Humanitas Medical Care, Bergamo (Camozzi) \| HMC = Humanitas Medical Care, Monza \| ICH = "Istituto Clinico Humanitas" - "Humanitas Ressearch Hospital", Rozzano (MI) \| ICZ = "Istituti Clinici Zucchi", Monza \| MOD = Poliambualtorio "Modoetia", Monza \| POLI = "Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda - Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico", Milano \| SAL = Private practice, Salerno

```{r}
#| label: table_services_by_place
#| echo: false

df_rep_place <- df_list[[2]]

df_rep_place |>
  mutate(
    Start = format(as.Date(Start), "%d-%m-%Y"),
    End = format(as.Date(End), "%d-%m-%Y")
  ) |>
  kbl(align = "c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_services_by_place
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_place,
  aes(x = reorder(Place, -Patients))
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = Patients),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Patients,
      label = Patients
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name =""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_place$Patients) * 1.1),
    breaks = seq(0, max(df_rep_place$Patients) * 1.1, by = 1000),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "SERVICES by PLACE (",
      year(min(df_rep_place$Start)),
      " - ",
      year(max(df_rep_place$End)),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

## 📈 SERVICES by YEAR

📌 The following chart presents the total volume of surgeries and procedures **performed by year**, illustrating the annual trends and workload distribution over time

```{r}
#| label: table_services_by_year
#| echo: false

df_rep_year <- df_list[[3]]

df_rep_year |>
  kbl(align = "c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_services_by_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

ggplot(
  data = df_rep_year,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = Patients
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    aes(y = Patients),
    stat = "identity",
    fill = "steelblue2",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Patients,
      label = Patients
    ),
    vjust = -0.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name ="",
    breaks = seq(
      min(df_rep_year$Year),
      max(df_rep_year$Year),
      by = 1
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    limits = c(0, max(df_rep_year$Patients) * 1.1),
    breaks = seq(0, max(df_rep_year$Patients) * 1.1, by = 250),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "SERVICES by YEAR (",
      min(df_rep_year$Year),
      " - ",
      max(df_rep_year$Year),
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  my_plot_theme
```

## 📈 SERVICES PROVIDED

📌 This chart details the breakdown of clinical activity by service type, highlighting the volume distribution between initial consultations, follow-up visits, and specialized procedures[^2]

[^2]: VISORT01 = Initial consultation \| VISORT02 = Follow-up consultation \| ECTBAC = Hip ultrasound for DDH screening \| MISC = Other services (e.g. cast removal, intra-articular or botulin injection)

```{r}
#| label: table_services
#| echo: false

df_rep_service <- df_list[[6]]

df_rep_service |>
  kbl(align = "c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  row_spec(which.max(df_rep_service$Patients), bold = TRUE, color = "red")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_services_treemap
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

df_rep_service <- df_rep_service |>
  mutate(
    bycentage = round((Patients / sum(Patients)) * 100, 1),
    Label = paste0(Service, " - ", bycentage, "%")
  )

treemap(
  df_rep_service,
  index = "Label",
  vSize = "Patients",
  type = "index",
  palette = c("#5ACEFF", "#4682B4", "#2B60DE", "#104E8B"),
  border.col = "black",
  border.lwds = 1.5,
  fontsize.labels = 12,
  fontface.labels = "bold",
  fontcolor.labels = "white",
  title = ""
)
```

## 📈 SERVICES by PLACE by YEAR

📌 The figure below illustrates the distribution and evolution of healthcare services rendered **across operational locations broken down by year**, highlighting annual volume trends by facility

```{r}
#| label: table_place_by_year
#| echo: false

df_rep_place_by_year <- df_list[[8]]

df_rep_place_by_year |>
  kbl(align = "c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_place_by_year), bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_place_by_year), italic = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_place_by_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

df_long_place_year <- df_rep_place_by_year |>
  filter(Year != "Total") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ICH, SAL, MOD, ICZ, POL, HMC, CAM),
    names_to = "Place",
    values_to = "Patients"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Place = factor(
      Place, 
      levels = c("ICH", "SAL", "MOD", "ICZ", "POL", "HMC", "CAM")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  data = df_long_place_year,
  aes(
    x = as.factor(Year),
    y = Patients,
    fill = Place
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6,
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#8AD2FF", "#5ACEFF", "#4682B4", "#3871E9", "#2B60DE", "#1D55B8", "#104E8B")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = ""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "SERVICES by PLACE by YEAR (",
      min(df_long_place_year$Year),
      " - ",
      max(df_long_place_year$Year),
      ")"
    ),
    fill = ""
  ) +
  my_plot_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## 📈 SERVICES by TYPE by YEAR

📌 The following figure presents the annual evolution of clinical services **classified by type and year**, highlighting shifts in procedural volumes over the observation period

```{r}
#| label: table_type_by_year
#| echo: false

df_rep_type_by_year <- df_list[[9]]

df_rep_type_by_year |>
  kbl(align = "c")|>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = "striped", 
    full_width = FALSE,      
    position = "center"
  ) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_type_by_year), bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_rep_type_by_year), italic = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot_services_type_by_year
#| echo: false
#| fig.align: 'center'

df_long_type_year <- df_rep_type_by_year |>
  filter(Year != "Total") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(VISORT01, VISORT02, ECTBAC, MISC),
    names_to = "Service",
    values_to = "Patients"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Service = factor(
      Service, 
      levels = c("VISORT01", "VISORT02", "ECTBAC", "MISC")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  data = df_long_type_year,
  aes(
    x = as.factor(Year),
    y = Patients,
    fill = Service
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6,
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#5ACEFF", "#4682B4", "#2B60DE", "#104E8B"),
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = ""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "SERVICES by TYPE by YEAR (",
      min(df_long_type_year$Year),
      " - ",
      max(df_long_type_year$Year),
      ")"
    ),
    fill = ""
  ) +
  my_plot_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```
